title: Birdland years: Hawkins, Dizzy's big band
summary: He worked Birdland with Hawkins, Bennie Green and Dizzy's big band.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: And what else were you doing in that period?
Well, I worked with Eckstine, I worked with Herbie Fields... I'm way ahead... I mean, there's some people I worked with way before I got to these people by now.
I was going to bring up Birdland, because that's when it started, in '50, I guess -- the end of '49 into '50.
I worked at Birdland quite a few times. I worked there with Hawk, Coleman Hawkins, and I worked there with my band, and I worked with Bennie Green and Dizzy...
What kind of a thing did you do there with Dizzy?
With the big band. He had a big band, and I played in the section.

No, that wasn't his dream band. In fact, I haven't heard his "dream band." The band that he had down at the Park a couple of weeks ago or something like that, I heard that, but I didn't think that was a dream band...
Well, they had a band at Birdland once with Dizzy, and they billed it as a "dream band,," and it was an all-star band, and that's why I thought you were in that...
Yeah, it could have been. I don't know. But I didn't know nothin' about it bein' no dream band.
